coordinates.object_orientation: Long shell axis +Z, spire up and surviving basal tip at z=0. Aperture faces front camera -Y, outer lip toward +X. Back hidden surface conservatively continuous without diagnostic inventions.

concept.reason: Actual same-specimen apertural preview and museum scale suffice for bounded fossil form; no concept image needed.

scope: Single fossil shell based on actual PRI78029 public preview; not living snail, not a copied scan. Preserve observed terminal truncation, do not extend missing siphonal tip.

scale.basis: PRI published approximate specimen length10cm. Width40mm/depth30mm are visual working proportions, not caliper data.
scale.uncertainty: Single oblique apertural preview inspected. Back form is conservative shell continuation, fine basal/columellar anatomy not inferred.

required_features: Bulging asymmetric body whorl dominates, tapering into low pointed spire above and narrow basal channel below; no cylindrical or conical cone-shell substitution.
Broad elongate teardrop aperture with raised irregular outer rim, narrowing continuously toward basal canal; aperture must be structural depression, not a painted black oval.
Apertural interior is shallow-to-moderate gray fossil surface in reference, possible sediment/weathering not diagnosed. Do not invent a deep open cavern or soft tissue.
Use only photographed surviving blunt terminal extent. Original plan long narrow basal channel means recognizable taper/groove, not permission to lengthen beyond specimen.
Spire has few subdued diminishing whorls and low ribs/growth texture; avoid turret tower or invented heavy spines.
Maintain broad inflated posterior body and thinner uneven lip. Original muted stone/ivory coloration only; no copied catalogue handwriting.
forbidden: Modern snail soft body or operculum
Catalogue numbers/handwriting or source image texture
